title: Northstar Peak
reference: repeat 5 { F1 turn_right } def F1 { forward while not on_switch { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } activate }
hints: The final climb. Every side is different, but each one ends at a relay.
F1: step off the relay first, then until you are on the next one, jump on yellow and go forward otherwise. Flip it. Main repeats F1 and turns right.
repeat 5 { F1 turn_right } def F1 { forward while not on_switch { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } activate }

story.intro: VANTA: "The Northstar beacon sees the whole city. Four relays stand between you and me, LoopBot, and you'll never reach them all."
story.outro: PATCH: "Relays down, beacon dark, and VANTA has nowhere left to run. Frostline is free. You did it, LoopBot."
